spec: 21 §13 (null-vs-zero-row and skip taxonomy), 21 §1.1 (counted tick, strategy tick), 21 §11 (zero-row fields), 21 §14 (failure rows), 21 §15 (eventsProcessed), 21 §17 (skipReason vocabularies), 12 §6.3, 12 §11, 20 §4.1
notes: Two skipReason vocabularies: top-level RunSingleMarketOutput.skipReason in {no_slug, no_resolution, unresolved_outcome, no_activity, incomplete_capture}; marketStats.skipReason in {no_in_window_activity} (MySQL enum).

`who` says which side decides. Rows decided by the TS shim (no spawn) are outside the Rust crate's reach; the binary test for them is that such a job cannot reach the binary at all because the schema requires the fields (21 §5.1).
A counted tick is a real (book, price_change) or synthetic tick counted BEFORE the window gate; eventsProcessed counts them (21 §15).

vectors.condition: fills or open positions (UP or DOWN qty > 0) at the end
vectors.craft: any session with at least one fill

vectors.condition: at least one counted tick, no fills, no UP/DOWN qty > 0 at the end (including when no tick passed the window gate)
vectors.craft: strategy that never places; input with ticks

zero_row_expectations.marketId: condition id of the first counted tick

vectors.spec: 21 §13 row 2 (including when no tick passed the window gate), 12 §5.4
vectors.condition: every counted tick lies outside the strategy window
vectors.craft: input whose events all precede start (ts-compat telonex-delta: tick.ts < startMs); the strategy is never called; eventsProcessed > 0; marketId still set from the first counted tick (21 §11)

vectors.spec: 21 §13 (zero-row money fields non-zero only for split/merge-only activity), 12 §9.5, 13 §5.4
vectors.condition: split 5 then merge 5, no fills, no positions at the end
vectors.market_stats: zero row with splitCost 5.00, pnl 0.00, cost 0.00, tradeCount 0
vectors.note: TS would persist pnl -5.00 (merge-PnL bug); classified, not copied

vectors.condition: split 5, never merged: UP 5 / DOWN 5 at the end
vectors.market_stats: full (positions > 0): upShares 5.00, downShares 5.00, mergableShares 5.00, splitCost 5.00, cost 0.00, pnl 0.00 (winner pays 5, split cost 5)

vectors.persisted: failure row no_market_stats: no_activity, class market_skip
vectors.craft: a valid telonex-delta input with no book/price_change rows for the market's tokens (or only non-tick event types)

expected_output.market.conditionId: null when no tick was observed (21 §10)

vectors.binary_side: unreachable: market.slug is required and must match ^btc-updown-(5m|15m)-[0-9]{10}$ (21 §5.1) -> invalid_input: market (exit 2) if a job without it is forced through
vectors.note: TS-side; covered by 21 §3 contract fixtures, listed here for completeness

vectors.binary_side: unreachable: market.tokenIds is required (21 §5.1) -> invalid_input: market
unreachable: market.outcome must be UP or DOWN (21 §5.1) -> invalid_input: market; a null outcome never reaches the binary

vectors.note: recorder-v4 input mode (M7); G2 outline only

vectors.condition: candidate panic, Err(StrategyError), cascade_limit or intent_meta_limit
vectors.market_stats: none: the candidate emits no MarketStats
vectors.persisted: failure row for that candidate only

vectors.spec: 21 §13 rules (a new marketStats.skipReason needs a DB migration and TS mapping first), 21 §17
vectors.statement: the binary never emits a marketStats.skipReason other than no_in_window_activity in schema v1

eventsProcessed = counted ticks (real + synthetic) before the window gate; eventsByType keys in {book, price_change, binance_agg_trade, chainlink_round}; values sum to eventsProcessed; strategyTicksSkipped is diagnostics only and never part of eventsProcessed
